question.en: How did Sam get his money back?
question.zh: 萨姆是怎么把钱要回来的？

sentences.en: How did Sam get his money back?
sentences.zh: 萨姆是怎么把钱要回来的？

sentences.en: The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money had been lost.
sentences.zh: 整个村子很快就知道有一大笔钱丢了。

sentences.zh: 当地的肉店老板萨姆·本顿，

sentences.en: had lost his wallet while taking his savings to the post office.
sentences.zh: 在把存款送往邮局的路上丢了钱包。

chunks.x: while taking his savings to the post office

sentences.en: Sam was sure that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers,
sentences.zh: 萨姆确信钱包一定是被某个村民捡到了，

sentences.en: but it was not returned to him.
Three months passed, and then one morning,
sentences.zh: 三个月过去了，后来一天早晨，

sentences.en: Sam found his wallet outside his front door.
sentences.zh: 萨姆在自己家大门外发现了钱包。

sentences.en: It had been wrapped up in newspaper and
it contained half the money he had lost,
sentences.zh: 里面装着他丢失的一半钱，

sentences.en: together with a note which said:
sentences.zh: 还附有一张纸条，上面写着：

sentences.en: In time, all Sam's money was paid back in this way.
sentences.zh: 终于，萨姆所有的钱都以这种方式还了回来。

sentences.en: The last note said: 'I am 100 per cent honest now!'
sentences.zh: 最后一张纸条上写着：“我现在是100%的诚实人了！”
